ai-draft.title: Written by this project's AI assistant
ai-draft.attribution: AI-assisted draft written from general knowledge. Not compared with any dictionary and not checked by a person.
ai-draft.usage: Everything with this source is unreviewed until a Mandarin teacher or other qualified person reviews it.

CC-CEDICT.title: CC-CEDICT, a community-maintained Chinese-English dictionary (distributed by MDBG)
CC-CEDICT.attribution: CC-CEDICT, https://cc-cedict.org, hosted by MDBG (https://www.mdbg.net). Entries copied or closely adapted from it must keep this attribution and the ShareAlike terms.
CC-CEDICT.usage: Guide for dictionary meanings and readings. Dictionary glosses are not automatically good answer buttons or classroom-ready: check sense, register and natural English before use.

HSK.title: Official HSK materials (name the edition and level in the ref, e.g. "HSK 3.0 (2021) level 1")
HSK.attribution: Used only as a guide to which beginner words to teach. Word lists are not copied.
HSK.usage: Always state the edition (HSK 2.0 and 3.0 differ).

Tatoeba.title: Tatoeba, a collection of sentences and translations
Tatoeba.license: CC BY 2.0 FR (some sentences CC0: check each sentence)
Tatoeba.attribution: Sentence author and Tatoeba sentence number, e.g. "sentence 1234567 by <author>".
Tatoeba.usage: Community sentences: each one must be reviewed individually for correctness, naturalness and level before use.
